definitions.explanation: Traditional Japanese festivals held during summer, often featuring food stalls, games, and fireworks.

examples.english: I'm going to the summer festival.

examples.japanese: {夏祭|なつまつ}りで{浴衣|ゆかた}を{着|き}た。
examples.english: I wore a yukata at the summer festival.

examples.japanese: {地元|じもと}の{夏祭|なつまつ}りは{毎年|まいとし}8{月|がつ}に{開|ひら}かれる。
examples.english: The local summer festival is held every year in August.

notes:
{夏祭|なつまつ}り are traditional Japanese festivals held during summer (July-August).

COMMON FEATURES:
- {屋台|やたい}: food stalls
- {花火|はなび}: fireworks
- {盆踊|ぼんおど}り: Bon dance
- {神輿|みこし}: portable shrine
- {浴衣|ゆかた}: summer kimono

FAMOUS SUMMER FESTIVALS:
- {祇園祭|ぎおんまつり} (Kyoto, July)
- {天神祭|てんじんまつり} (Osaka, July)
- {ねぶた{祭|まつ}り (Aomori, August)

RELATED WORDS:
- {祭|まつ}り: festival (general)
- {花火|はなび}{大会|たいかい}: fireworks display
- お{盆|ぼん}: Obon period
- {縁日|えんにち}: fair/festival day
